destinations.name: The Farm
destinations.short: Forest trails, open fields, farm life and campfire evenings, a short drive from the city.
overview: The Farm is our home ground in Katuulo, along Bujuuko-Mityana Road. It is a working farm with forest trails, open lawns, quiet corners and plenty of room for children to run.
Spend a day on the adventure courses, join a family challenge, harvest vegetables and cook them yourself, or slow down with yoga, bird watching and a campfire under the stars.
Whether you come with children, colleagues or a partner, every visit is built around time outdoors and time together.
